answer_1.quote: A machine translation task can be formally defined as a sequence to sequence generation problem: given the source sentence X = {x 1 , x 2 , ..., x N }, to generate the target sentence Y = {y 1 , y 2 , ..., y T } according to the conditional probability P (Y |X; θ), where θ denotes the parameter set of a network.
answer_1.outputs: target sentence Y = {y 1 , y 2 , ..., y T }
